meta_title: Daniel Aldrich Plumbing | Central Heating Derby
meta_description: Daniel Aldrich Plumbing and Heating in Derby. Expert boiler installation, repairs and servicing. Fast, reliable heating engineers. Call now for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Same-Day Emergency Heating Repair
hero_subhead: Broken boiler or cold radiators in Derby? We're out within the hour, day or night, with parts on the van.
services_heading: Complete Central Heating Services Across Derby
services_subhead: From annual boiler servicing to emergency repairs and full heating system overhauls, we handle every job with care and expertise.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: Supply and fit modern condensing boilers with 10-year warranties. We'll advise you on the right size and fuel type for your home, then handle all pipework and testing.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler efficient and safe — we check all safety controls, clean the heat exchanger, and spot problems before they become expensive. Emergency repairs available 24/7.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: New radiators fitted with thermostatic valves to cut heating bills. We also repair leaks, bleed air from systems, and balance heat distribution across your home.

services.title: Central Heating System Overhaul
services.desc: Replace worn pipework, upgrade outdated controls, or add a smart thermostat. We'll design a system that heats your home efficiently and saves you money each winter.

services.title: Landlord Safety Inspections
services.desc: Full annual gas safety checks and certificates for rental properties. We test all appliances and ensure your tenancies meet legal requirements.

services.title: Powerflushing & System Cleaning
services.desc: Remove sludge and debris from your heating pipes to restore efficiency and stop cold radiators. Often solves noisy pipes and extends boiler life by years.

about_pullquote: I started this because I was tired of seeing people overcharged for simple heating fixes.
about_para_1: Daniel Aldrich Plumbing and Heating has been keeping Derby homes warm for 18 years. What started as a one-man operation in Spondon has grown into a trusted local name — built on turning up on time, fixing things properly, and charging fairly. Gas Safe Registered and fully insured, we handle everything from routine boiler checks to complete heating system replacements.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, explain the problem in plain English, and never rush the job. Whether you need an emergency repair at 11pm or a planned system upgrade, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own. You won't find hidden charges or hard-sell tactics here — just honest heating expertise and a guarantee you'll feel the difference.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed up on a Sunday morning in January — nightmare. Daniel was here by 10am, diagnosed a faulty pump, and had us back up and running by lunchtime. Professional, friendly, and the price was very fair. Can't ask for more than that really.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had my annual service done before winter. Daniel explained everything he was checking and spotted a small leak in the pipework that could have caused real trouble later. Fixed it on the spot. Much better than the last engineer I had — actually listened and did thorough work.
reviews.author: Patricia R.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted last month. Daniel took time to explain the controls and make sure we were happy with everything. No mess left behind, no faffing about, just a clean job and a cuppa at the end. Heating bills already look better. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: James M.
